HINDRANCES

BIG MOUTH (MINOR): The truth must be heard.

CURIOUS (MAJOR): You can't write an award-winning story without all the facts!

STUBBORN (MINOR): Nothing will stop you from getting the story.

EDGES

ALERTNESS: Nothing escapes your attention. You add +2 to all Notice rolls.

CALCULATING: Ignore up to 2 points of penalties on one action when you have an Action Card of Five or less.

GUTS: You get a free reroll on Fear tests. You can't get the story if you're running away!

INVESTIGATOR: +2 to Research and Notice rolls made to spot clues in written material, piles of junk, or similar tasks.

LEVEL-HEADED: Draw an additional Action Card each round in combat and choose which one to use.

GEAR

LeMat Revolver (pistol—Range 12/24/49, Damage 2d6, RoF 1, Shots 9 or Range; shotgun—Range 5/10/20, Damage 1-3d6, RoF 1, Shots 1), .40 ammo (×50), shotgun ammo (×20), journal, various pens and pencils, box camera with 10 plates, satchel to carry your professional gear in, $207.
